This is a square plate, about 24–26 cm across, holding a mound of white rice and a portion of roasted carrots.

- **Rice:** The mound covers roughly half the plate, so I estimate about 200 g of cooked rice. At about 1.3 kcal/g, that is roughly 260 kcal.
- **Carrots:** There are about 7 roasted pieces, around 90 g in total. With some oil on them, I estimate about 70 kcal.

That gives roughly 290 g of food and 330 kcal; I rounded the energy up slightly for any added fat.
